commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+2' Here is a change. Serhou Guirassy is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Silas (VfB Stuttgart).
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jamie Leweling trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart).
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. There is a free kick near the sideline to Stuttgart.
89' A pass into the penalty area from Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) is intercepted by the defence.
87' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Stuttgart are awarded the free kick.

85' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul and Deniz Aytekin immediately signals a free kick. It's a free kick to Stuttgart, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
85' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
84' Makoto Hasebe will be replaced by Marko Mladenovic (Eintracht Frankfurt).

84' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Fabian Bredlow has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. They send men into the box.
82' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
80' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

80' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. The ball goes out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.
78' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Atakan Karazor and he is replaced by Mahmoud Dahoud (VfB Stuttgart).
78' Substitution. Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Deniz Undav walks off.

76' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Fabian Bredlow pulls off a great save to stop his attempt towards the top left corner.

74' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card. Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) jumps into a tackle and Deniz Aytekin signals a foul. Eintracht Frankfurt win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
73' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
73' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
73' Donny van de Beek (Eintracht Frankfurt) brings his opponent down. Deniz Aytekin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Stuttgart are awarded a free kick.
71' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes a short corner kick.

71' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) plants a good close-range header towards goal from the corner kick, but it comes to nothing as a defender comfortably blocks the effort. The ball goes behind for a corner. Stuttgart will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

69' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
69' The attendance for today's match is 66441.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jean Bahoya leaves the pitch and Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
66' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Niels Nkounkou will be replaced by Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt).
65' Substitution. Hugo Larsson did his best and is replaced by Donny van de Beek (Eintracht Frankfurt).
65' A substitution has been made. Chris Fuhrich is replaced by Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart).

65' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
61' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
60' Eintracht Frankfurt are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
56' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.

55' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
53' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
52' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a cross into the box, but Fabian Bredlow comes off his line to gather the ball.
50' Deniz Aytekin shows the yellow card to Makoto Hasebe (Eintracht Frankfurt) for a heavy challenge.
46' Half-time substitution. Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) will not participate anymore and Hugo Ekitike is coming on.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Stuttgart.

45+6' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball. It's a free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt in a dangerous position.
45+3' Makoto Hasebe (Eintracht Frankfurt) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Stuttgart have a free kick.
45+1' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Deniz Aytekin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
44' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
43' Jean Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
43' Jean Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
41' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
41' Eintracht Frankfurt quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
41' Willian Pacho (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence. Eintracht Frankfurt earn a corner.
37' 3 - 0 Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) receives a killer pass and scores a great goal after finding the back of the net with a simple finish!
36' Stuttgart are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
34' A player from Stuttgart commits a rough challenge. Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a free kick near the side line.
34' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) is able to continue to play.
34' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
33' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
33' The game is interrupted now, Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
32' The resulting corner from Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

31' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Kevin Trapp comes off the line to clear the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Stuttgart.

28' Fabian Bredlow pulls off a great save to deny Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
27' Fabian Bredlow is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt). Easy save!
27' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle and signals a foul after Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) brought his opponent down. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a free kick.
26' Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
25' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) sees a yellow card from Deniz Aytekin after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
23' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
21' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
20' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
17' 2 - 0 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 2:0.
14' Referee Deniz Aytekin points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Stuttgart players.
11' 1 - 0 Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) controls the ball and converts a killer cross with a powerful blast that goes into the top of the net. Spectacular finish!
11' Attention! Referee Deniz Aytekin straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
11' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) has a goal ruled out for offside!
9' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) sends a long ball in, but Kevin Trapp comfortably gathers the ball.
6' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
3' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

2' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
1' Deniz Aytekin blows the whistle, Makoto Hasebe (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Stuttgart.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Eintracht Frankfurt will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Deniz Aytekin.
